problem:
Given 
$A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 8 \\ 1 & 8 & 16 \\ 0 & 12 & 24\end{aligned}]$,
which of the following elementary row operations makes ${a}_{22}=0?$
worked_solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation 

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1}.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 8 \\ 1 & 8 & 16 \\ 0 & 12 & 24\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2)\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 8 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 12 & 24\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1}.
$$
